statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The procedure was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes submitted are I47.1 and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
